definitions.gloss: village chief, village head, village mayor
definitions.explanation: The elected head of a village (村) in Japan's local government system. Villages are the smallest unit of municipal government, found mainly in rural areas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{村長|そんちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: A new village mayor was elected.

examples.japanese: {村長|そんちょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{村民|そんみん}→村民：22347_sonmin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{傾|かたむ}けた→傾ける：11516_katamukeru⟧。
examples.english: The village chief listened to the villagers' voices.

examples.japanese: {村長|そんちょう}{選挙|せんきょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{立候補者|りっこうほしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧しかいない。
examples.english: The village mayoral election will be held next month, but there is only one candidate.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japan's local government hierarchy, the heads of different municipal levels have different titles:
- ⟦{市長|しちょう}→市長：12472_shichou⟧: city mayor
- ⟦{町長|ちょうちょう}→町長：13580_chouchou⟧: town mayor
- {村長|そんちょう}: village mayor

⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧ (village) is the smallest administrative unit. The number of villages in Japan has been declining due to municipal mergers.

NOTE: This is a homophone of ⟦{尊重|そんちょう}→尊重：03327_sonchou⟧ (respect).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {村長|そんちょう}{選挙|せんきょ}: village mayoral election
- {村長|そんちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就任|しゅうにん}→就任：12368_shuunin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take office as village chief
- {村長|そんちょう}⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧: village chief's office
